must_catch.item: The real trigger is the CFO's month-end close, not the portal.
No dollar figure is stated. The rep doesn't know it.
The global/infrastructure opener is reported as silence.

data.notes: The report gets the core story right: the portal was the way in, the real trigger was the new CFO's nine-day close, and the win came from a value case built on her own statements ('that's my number, not yours'). It keeps both Fiserv's pitch and the dollar figure unknown. Weaknesses: the gaps section labels 'She let it go' as fact when it is the rep's opinion, and it does not say the unproven counter-reader promise carries into the 14-branch rollout. The messaging changes also omit the proof-building item (a distributor reference and a counter-reader demo); it appears only in the gaps section. The trigger insight misreads 'building a portal' versus 'aren't building anything' as a contradiction, and 'go back' is cited with no speaker.
